SELECT concat_ws('',fp2.FINPROD_ABBR,'(',fp2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,')') AS inProdName, concat_ws('',fp3.FINPROD_ABBR,'(',fp3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,')') AS outprodName, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 AS trdType1, fp1.PROFIT_TYPE AS trdType2, fp1.FINPROD_ABBR AS assetName, fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS assetId, DATE_FORMAT(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS tradeDate ,
DATE_FORMAT(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS settleDate ,
100 AS unitCprice, if(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PRIN_AMT=null,0, IFNULL(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT,0)/TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PRIN_AMT*100 ) AS unitFprice,
IFNULL(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PRIN_AMT,0)/10000 AS tradeAmt, IFNULL(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT,0) AS fpriceAmt, '0' AS yield FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD dadd ON dadd.TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa ON fpa.PORTFOLIO_ID = dadd.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp3 ON fp3.FINPROD_ID = fpa.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp1 ON fp1.FINPROD_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp2 ON fp2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.COUNTER_ID WHERE TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 ='F17' AND fp1.PROFIT_TYPE = '02'
